item.title: I’m 36 And I’m Running Out Of Eggs
item.description: Last night, I sat on the floor of my apartment, staring at a blank wall. It was only 8 p.m., but the day had hollowed me out. I finished the food I ordered and went to bed early. Not because I was tired, but because I didn't know what else to do with myself.
